title: Famous things and what they were first made for

source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia

use.match: Match each thing to what it was first made for.
use.reverse: Which of these was first made for {value}?

rows.label: Coca-Cola
rows.use: a patent medicine sold as a nerve tonic
rows.description: carbonated brown-colored soft drink
rows.hook: is a fizzy brown soft drink with a secret formula, bottled in a curvy glass shape with a red logo

rows.label: Tarot
rows.use: a trick-taking card game in northern Italy
rows.description: set of cards used for games or divination
rows.hook: is a deck of 78 cards, including The Fool and The Moon, that fortune-tellers lay out to read futures

rows.label: Pepsi
rows.use: a drink to aid digestion
rows.description: soft drink owned and manufactured by PepsiCo
rows.hook: is the cola that fights the cola wars, known for its blue-and-red globe logo

rows.label: sushi
rows.use: a way to keep fish from spoiling in fermented rice
rows.description: portioned prepared vinegared rice topped or rolled with other ingredients
rows.hook: is a Japanese dish of vinegared grains with seafood, served as nigiri or in seaweed rolls

rows.label: Monopoly
rows.use: a lesson on how hoarding land hurts ordinary people
rows.description: economics-themed board game
rows.hook: has players buy streets, build houses and hotels and bankrupt rivals, with a top hat token

rows.label: Botulinum toxin
rows.use: calming eye muscle spasms
rows.description: group of eight neurotoxic proteins produced by Clostridium botulinum

rows.label: gunpowder
rows.use: an alchemists' hunt for an elixir of life
rows.description: explosive most commonly used as propellant in firearms
rows.hook: is a mix of saltpeter, sulfur and charcoal, invented in China, that made cannons and muskets possible

rows.label: gin
rows.use: a herbal medicine
rows.description: distilled alcoholic drink
rows.hook: is a spirit flavored with juniper berries, mixed with tonic in a classic highball

rows.label: sildenafil
rows.use: a heart-disease treatment for chest pain
rows.description: medication used to treat erectile dysfunction and pulmonary arterial hypertension

rows.label: steam engine
rows.use: draining water out of mines
rows.description: heat engine that performs mechanical work using steam as its working fluid
rows.hook: is a piston machine run on heated vapor that powered locomotives and the Industrial Revolution

rows.label: Mountain Dew
rows.use: a lemon-lime mixer for bourbon
rows.description: carbonated soft drink brand

rows.label: minoxidil
rows.use: a pill for high blood pressure
rows.description: chemical compound

rows.label: roller coaster
rows.use: hauling coal down a mountain
rows.description: type of amusement ride found at amusement parks and carnivals
rows.hook: is a thrill ride of steep drops, loops and tight turns on a looping track, found at theme parks

rows.label: marshmallow
rows.use: a throat-soothing remedy from a plant root
rows.description: sugar-based confection
rows.hook: is a soft, spongy white sweet that people toast on sticks over a campfire for s'mores

rows.label: WD-40
rows.use: keeping rust off a missile's skin
rows.description: lubricating oil and water displacement spray

rows.label: tonic water
rows.use: a way to take quinine against malaria
rows.description: carbonated soft drink in which quinine is dissolved
rows.hook: is a bitter fizzy mixer that glows under a black light and is paired with gin

rows.label: margarine
rows.use: a cheap butter substitute for soldiers and the poor
rows.description: semi-solid oily spread often used as a butter substitute
rows.hook: is a spread made mostly from vegetable oil, sold in tubs and sticks as a stand-in for dairy

rows.label: duct tape
rows.use: sealing military ammunition cases against water
rows.description: type of adhesive tape

rows.label: chainsaw
rows.use: helping surgeons deliver babies
rows.description: high-powered handheld saw with a rotating chain

rows.label: corn flakes
rows.use: a health food for sanitarium patients
rows.description: type of breakfast cereal
rows.hook: is a toasted breakfast cereal made by the Kellogg brothers, topped by a rooster mascot on the box

rows.label: Play-Doh
rows.use: a cleaner for wiping soot off wallpaper
rows.description: modeling compound used by young children for art and craft projects
